{{Quote|Leia says there's going to be a big celebration later, and advised me to shower and rest. I've just realized how hungry I am. A feast certainly sounds good. We've got a lot to celebrate. And to remember.|Extract from Luke Skywalker's journal|<ref name="FFJ">''[[Star Wars Journal: The Fight for Justice]]''</ref>}}
A '''Royal Award Ceremony''', also referred to as the '''Yavin Ceremony''',<ref name="topps">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: A New Hope|cardname=Yavin Ceremony|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/87473/cid/6296567/2013-Topps-Star-Wars-Illustrated-A-New-Hope-100-Yavin-Ceremony}}</ref> was held within the ruins of the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. During this ceremony, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], honored [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] for their heroic roles in destroying the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].

In front of hundreds of [[Alliance Military/Legends|troops]] and [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] were awarded the [[Medal of Bravery/Legends|Medal of Bravery]], the highest decoration for military valor given by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] partners that carried the Death Star [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to Yavin, also received honors during the ceremony, being placed on the podium on the side of the Princess.

The awarding ceremony was followed by a series of speeches from Alliance officials, and then a feast, during which many [[Toast (ritual)/Legends|toasts]] were drunk in honor of the new heroes, and Chewbacca was awarded his own [[Gold/Legends|gold]] medal. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] after the victory at Yavin, when a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had been founded, those who originally attended the ceremony retained fond memories of it, as the crowning event of the Alliance.

==History==
{{Quote|They were in the wrong place at the wrong time. Naturally, they became heroes.|Leia Organa|<ref name="ANHN" />}}
[[File:Heroes_of_Yavin.png|thumb|left|250px|The Heroes of Yavin met on a mission to rescue Princess Leia from the Death Star.]]
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] engaged in its first decisive [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the outcome of which was the first major victory against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. This [[Realspace/Legends|space]] battle, known as the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], occurred in the shadow of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]],<ref name="GSWU2">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> and resulted in the the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="GSWU2" /> The victory at Yavin was the work of a set of unusual heroes: [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|farmboy]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] turned [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Apprentice]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], Solo's [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] copilot. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], who had been rescued from the Imperials by the heroes, became the figurehead of the Alliance. The [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astro droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and his colleague [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol unit]] with a [[Gold/Legends|golden]] plating, were also associated with the heroes, since they had carried the Death Star [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] from Tatooine to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="ANH" />

===Preparations===
{{Quote|Han Solo has refused to participate in the ceremony. Luke tried to talk him into it, but it didn't do any good. So Luke came to me. He asked me to try. "Use your diplomatic skills," he said.|Extract from Leia Organa's journal|<ref name="CTE" />}}
Following the victory, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vanden Willard/Legends|Vanden Willard]] suggested that a triumph ceremony was in order, to which Princess Leia agreed.<ref name="CTE" /> As the Alliance's headquarters were located in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on Yavin 4, the ominous [[Grand Audience Chamber]]&mdash;the [[Stone/Legends|stone]] hall located at the top of the Temple&mdash;was chosen to host the ceremony. While the Chamber was being prepared for the gathering, Leia Organa suggested Luke Skywalker to take a [[Shower/Legends|shower]] and some time to [[Sleep/Legends|rest]] in the meantime.<ref name="FFJ" /> When the Princess heard that the Corellian pilot Han Solo intended to frown upon the celebration, she summoned him to her chambers in the [[Senatorial Quarters]]. Organa tried to convince Solo to show up, though she still was not sure he would at the end of their conversation. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] companions of the heroes were also prepared for the ceremony. The astromech droid R2-D2, who had sustained [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] damage during the Death Star trench run, had been repaired and shined. His golden partner C-3PO was so anxious to look pristine that he asked four times for more metal polish,<ref name="CTE" /> and a dent in his head had been repaired.<ref name="Insider88">{{InsiderCite|98|Set Piece|Set Piece: Massassi Temple}}</ref> The two robots nearly missed the ceremony, as the grooming of R2-D2 had taken longer than expected, but they finally made it in time.<ref name="ATD">[[Droids (1986) 8|''Droids'' (1986) 8]]</ref>

===The ceremony===
{{Quote|Suddenly, the door zoomed open, and there we were. Rebels were lined up in formation like they were the leaders of the entire Galactic Empire.|Han Solo to Sai'da|<ref name="SWJHH">''[[Star Wars Journal: Hero for Hire]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Victory_Celebration_ANH.png|thumb|300px|The Heroes of Yavin enter the Grand Chamber.]]
In the morning that followed the battle,<ref name="TDADS">{{StoryCite|story=The Day after the Death Star!|book=Star Wars Weekly 97}}</ref> while they were waiting outside the Grand Chamber, the very nervous Skywalker, Solo and Chewbacca discussed their newfound glory at the Battle of Yavin. When the farmboy from Tatooine asked the smuggler why he had returned to save the day at the last moment, Solo humorously answered it was all his Wookiee friend's doing. Their conversation was interrupted when a Rebel officer announced them everything was ready for the ceremony.<ref name="SWR">[[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]</ref> The presentation officially began when Skywalker, Solo and Chewbacca entered the Grand Audience Chamber to the sound of the trumpets. The heroes were dressed in their finest: Solo wore a fresh-pressed cream [[shirt]] he had been saving for a special occasion, and Skywalker wore a black tunic under an Alliance-issue yellow flight jacket.<ref name="ANHJN">[[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' junior novel]]</ref> For the first time, Skywalker also wore a long barreled [[Defender sporting blaster pistol/Legends|sporting blaster]] at his side.<ref name="Insider88" /> Hundreds of troops were gathered on either side of the hall,<ref name="ANH" /> and members of the [[Rebel Honor Guard/Legends|Rebel Honor Guard]], most of whom were among the surviving Alderaanians, acted as sentries.<ref name="Honor Guard">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=#10: Rebel Honor Guard (Yavin)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tac10rebguard.asp}}</ref> Down the center aisle past all their troops, the Alliance officials stood on a raised dais.<ref name="ANH" /> Princess Leia Organa, who had been asked to preside the formal ceremony, wore the trademark white dress of the [[House of Organa/Legends|Alderaan Royal Family]]<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> and an ancient [[Organa's Ceremonial Necklace|family necklace]].<ref name="Premiere Limited">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Organa's Ceremonial Necklace}}</ref> She was flanked by the generals Vanden Willard<ref name="CTE" /> and [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], and the Rebel [[Senator/Legends|senators]]. The refurbished R2-D2 and C-3PO were also on the podium.<ref name="ANH" /> [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] member [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], who had served alongside Skywalker in the battle, also attended the ceremony among the lined up soldiers. He had undergone an award ceremony of his own&mdash;receiving the rank of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] and the [[Star of Alderaan/Legends|Star of Alderaan]]&mdash;earlier for his role in the battle<ref name="X-Wing Official Strategy Guide">''[[X-Wing Collector's CD-ROM: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>

[[File:Heroes_of_Yavin_and_their_medals.png|thumb|left|300px|Skywalker and Solo receive their award from the hands of Leia Organa.]]The heroes of the day then walked down the aisle, the two Humans in the front, followed by the Wookiee. When the three friends reached the end of the room, the troops made a quarter turn to the left in order to face the dais.<ref name="ANH" /> Chewbacca stopped on a lower step than his companions because he was uncomfortable with the situation.<ref name="ANHJN" /> Princess Leia stepped forward and placed the [[Medal of Bravery/Legends|Medal of Bravery]] around Solo's neck, who winked at her with a smile. The Princess then repeated the ceremony with the young Skywalker, who was very moved.<ref name="ANH" />

Each of the heroes reacted to the royal honors according to his personality&mdash;Chewbacca was confused and showed signs of running for cover,<ref name="ANHN" /> Solo couldn't take his award seriously and Skywalker humbly realized what a tribute he was being paid.<ref name="FFJ" /> The shined-up R2-D2 started beeping with happiness, showing how proud he was of his new masters,<ref name="SWI111">{{InsiderCite|111|Inside Artoo!}}</ref> and his friend C-3PO patted the small droid's dome in approval. The heroes then bowed to the princess, turned and finally faced the assembly, who gave full vent to their feelings by applauding and cheering loudly.<ref name="ANH" /> Although he did not receive his medal, General Jan Dodonna stood proudly in front of the amassed soldiers and technicians, as he knew many of them cheered for him, too.<ref name="EGC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

===Merry-making and last-minute award===
{{Quote|Up you go, your worship&mdash;there's unfinished business that was a bit too lofty for the steps of the Ceremonial Hall.|Han Solo to Leia Organa|<ref name="TDADS" />}}
[[File:Toast_in_the_Audience_Chamber.png|thumb|200px|During the feast, many toasts were drunk following the destruction of the Death Star.]]
Once the official ceremony was over, the Grand Audience chamber transformed into a reception hall and hosted a grand feast. The victory against the Galactic Empire had been a great one to the Alliance, and so too was the merry-making in its name. During the party, the [[Toast (ritual)/Legends|toasts]] came often and exuberantly, with many attendants rising their glasses in honor of the Heroes of Yavin. At some point during the revelry, Solo and Skywalker carried the Princess away, arguing there was "unfinished business" that needed to be taken care of.<ref name="TDADS" /> Indeed, Chewbacca had not received a medal, as Wookiees would not put any meaning into tangible awards.<ref name="BTM" /> However, his [[Human/Legends|Human]] friends decided he deserved his Medal of Bravery regardless. The Princess of Alderaan, who was too short to reach the Wookiee's neck, stood on a table and presented Chewbacca with his own decoration.<ref name="TDADS" /> A [[Yavin triumph ceremony|second celebration]] was thereafter organized on the lush [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Wookiees, so Chewbacca could share his pride with his entire [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="BTM" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Every time we come in here, I think of those old videoclips of the ceremony where Mother handed out medals to Uncle Luke and Dad. She looked so pretty.''"<br />"''Yeah, and Dad looked like such a ... such a pirate.''"<br />"''Well, he was a smuggler in those days.|Jaina and Jacen Solo|<ref name="YJKHF">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Heirs of the Force]]''</ref>}}
Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Han Solo mentioned the Award Ceremony when [[Sai'da]], a history-enthusiast [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Monk]], asked him about the his involvement with the Alliance. Solo confessed his initial reluctance to stay for the ceremony and admitted that Princess Leia was the one who got him to do it. The Corellian then gave Sai'da a detailed and somewhat emotional account of the event. Solo stated the ceremony made him wonder what kind of better man he could become, not just how he would make the next [[Currency/Legends|cash]] transaction.<ref name="SWJHH" /> The [[5 ABY/Legends|following year]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Solo and the Princess Organa planned on getting [[Marriage/Legends|married]], and [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa (5 ABY)|the ceremony]] was to take place in the Grand Audience Chamber. While standing on the dais with the groom, Luke Skywalker mused that the wedding day was very much like the Royal Award Ceremony.<ref name="POB">[[Prophets of the Dark Side (novel)|''Prophets of the Dark Side'']]</ref> However, the wedding was interrupted when a [[HoloNet transceiver implant|mind-controlled]] [[Triclops]], son of the late [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], broke into the Chamber. That incident set the [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|actual wedding]] back<ref name="SPINblog">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-spy-game-spin-declassified|text=The ''Star Wars'' Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|int=The Star Wars Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|nolive=1}}</ref> for [[8 ABY/Legends|three more years]].<ref name="COPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

[[File:Luke_alone_in_the_Chamber-JKJO.png|thumb|left|200px|The Grand Audience Chamber in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], now part of Luke Skywalker's Jedi Academy]]
[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, the Galactic Empire was defeated, and the Alliance established a democratic government, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The Great Temple of Yavin 4 had become a [[Jedi academy]] where Luke Skywalker, now a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], taught many students the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Every time he gathered his apprentices in the Grand Audience Chamber, Skywalker had fond memories of the victory celebration following the destruction of the Death Star, remembering how Princess Leia had presented medals to him and Han Solo and Chewbacca.<ref name="DA">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref> Images and sounds from the Royal Award Ceremony had been recorded so the future generations could watch [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] rebroadcasts of this important milestone in the history of the Alliance. Although the official holo had been lost at some point before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], one of the [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]] who attended the ceremony had taped it for himself, which allowed to preserve its memory.<ref name="SWC3">[[Chewbacca (2000) 3|''Chewbacca'' (2000) 3]]</ref>
The young [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]], daughter of Han Solo and Leia Organa, had seen the tape. She once commented on the beauty of her mother, to which her brother [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] added their father looked like a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]].<ref name="YJKHF" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|At the far end stands a vision in white, the beautiful young Senator Leia. Luke and the others solemnly march up the long aisle and kneel before Senator Leia.|Extract from the final script of ''A New Hope''|<ref name="BTM" />}}
[[File:Yavin_celebration_at_Shepperton.jpg|thumb|250px|The triumph ceremony was filmed at Shepperton Studios, England.]]
The triumphal celebration on Yavin 4 is the final scene of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the first installment of the [[original trilogy]], released in [[1977]].<ref name="ANH" /> The scene was shot at the massive H Stage of [[Shepperton Studios]], located in [[Wikipedia:Shepperton|Shepperton]], [[Wikipedia:England|England]]. Most of the interior scenes had been filmed at [[Elstree Studios]], just outside of [[Wikipedia:London|London]], but Elstree could not, at the time, offer a stage large enough to portray the Audience Chamber, and the shooting was relocated to Shepperton.<ref name="BTM" /> This scene was filmed over two days, [[May 13]] and [[May 14|14]] [[1976]], right in the middle of principal photography, when the camaraderie had grown between the main actors.<ref name="Insider88" /> The extras hired to portray the assembled troops wore orange [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] pilot costumes and olive-green [[Wikipedia:United States Marine Corps|US Marine]] suits.<ref name="JedArch">{{InsiderCite|111|Jedi Archive}}</ref> Aside from R2-D2's bleeping and Chewbacca's roar, the scene featured no line<ref name="ANH" /> and was highlighted by "[[The Throne Room]]," a march written by [[John Williams]] and performed by the [[London Symphony Orchestra]].

The filmmakers originally intended to portray the assembly of Rebels present for the ceremony using a matte painting. However, this proved too difficult, and the scene was filmed by moving the extras to different positions in the frame until the illusion of an large assembly was achieved: the extras were first filmed at the near end of the stage, then relocated to the middle, and finally to the far end of the room. According to ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'', the extras were anything but reverent toward [[Harrison Ford]] and [[Mark Hamill]], who portrayed Han Solo and Luke Skywalker. Extras believed the film would be a flop, and whispered insults, openly mocking the actors while they were walking down the set.<ref name="BTM" /> Originally, the droids R2-D2 and C-3PO, played by [[Kenny Baker]] and [[Anthony Daniels]], were meant to march up the aisle with the rest of the characters. However, due to their costumes' limitations, Baker and Daniels could not climb stairs, so it was decided that the droids would wait on the platform with the Princess.<ref name="Steps">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/classic/2002/04/classic20020403.html|text=Episode IV Classic Moment - Seizing the Day}}</ref> On her performance as Leia Organa in the final scene, [[Carrie Fisher]] once declared: "The last line in the script was that the Princess is way down the hall and she is staggeringly beautiful. I crossed off the 'ly' and 'beautiful' and felt this new wording more approached what I would bring to the character."<ref name="LAL">{{InsiderCite|23|Life After Leia: Carrie Fisher Now Wages Battles with Pen Instead of Lightsaber}}</ref>

[[File:Triumph_of_the_Will_-_Congress_Hall.jpg|thumb|left|The ceremony from ''Triumph des Willens'']]
This end ceremony segment emulates, almost shot-for-shot, a similar scene in [[Wikipedia:Triumph of the Will|''Triumph des Willens'']], a [[1930s|1934]] Nazi propaganda film made by [[Wikipedia:Leni Riefenstahl|Leni Riefenstahl]]. Both segments feature a large and enthusiastic crowd gathered in a ceremony hall bounded by columns, with a low podium where the leader stands&mdash;in ''Triumph des Willens'', [[Wikipedia:Adolf Hitler|Adolf Hitler]] was the leader in question.<ref name="BTM" /> This similarity is unusual, as the Nazi references in ''Star Wars'' generally involve the Galactic Empire of Palpatine, whose authoritarian regime mirrors Hitler's Third Reich.<ref name="MOM">[[Star Wars: The Magic of Myth (book)|''Star Wars: The Magic of Myth'']]</ref>

Many of the versions of the movie script ended with a celebration. In the rough and first drafts, Princess Leia was crowned Queen, and in the third and early fourth drafts, Obi-Wan Kenobi attended the ceremony, having survived his encounter with Darth Vader. In the novel adaptation of ''A New Hope'', the scene was almost identical to the one in the movie, with the added detail of the Grand Audience Chamber being decorated in "the banners of the many worlds which had lent their support to the Rebellion." The novelization also has C-3PO marching down the aisle beside the heroes, with R2-D2 joining the group once they reach the dais.<ref name="BTM" /> The ''Star Wars'' [[Star Wars (radio)|radio dramatization]] also presented an alternate version of the scene, complete with dialogue from all of the major players&mdash;such as Princess Leia giving a speech and Luke Skywalker commenting on how R2-D2 had been repaired.<ref name="SWR" /> While this event has been mostly referred to as "the ceremony", its official name was revealed by the protocol droid C-3PO in the [[Droids (1986) 8|final issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Droids (1986)|''Star Wars: Droids'']] series of comics: "Yes, you ''will'' look nice for the Award Ceremony Art&mdash;the Royal Award Ceremony?"<ref name="ATD" />

===Non-canon depictions and in-continuity nods===
In the [[1993]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]'', the Ceremony appears as the epilogue of the game. It appears using shots from the first movie. Only one individual, [[Rookie One]], is seen walking the corridor. It is actually an animation of Luke Skywalker, being digitally isolated from Han Solo and Chewbacca.<ref name="RA">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]''</ref>

The Award Ceremony was also featured in a number of sources that are not considered [[canon]]ical. In the [[2000]] one-shot humor comic book ''[[Sergio Aragonés Stomps Star Wars]]'', where author [[Sergio Aragonés]] portrayed himself as a delusional ''Star Wars'' fan who got accidentally into the digitized reels of ''Star Wars Episode IV''. The ending segment of the story showed digitizing experts downloading Aragonés out of the film, just as Princess Leia was about to kiss him in front of the assembled Rebels. This version of the ceremony has two Rebel soldiers acting as [[Wikipedia:CNN|Cable News Network]] reporters filming the scene.<ref name="SASSW">''[[Sergio Aragonés Stomps Star Wars]]''</ref>

In the equally jocular [[2001]] comic [[Tag & Bink Are Dead 2|''Tag & Bink Are Dead'' 2]], the title characters [[Tag Greenly|Tag Greenley]] and [[Bink Otauna/Legends|Bink Otauna]] wound up in the Grand Audience Chamber [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Evacuation of Yavin]]. The only things they found were leftover trash from the Rebel award ceremony, including a torn-down astromech droid, various party hats, confetti, streamers, noisemakers and a [[Rabbit/Legends|rabbit]] costume. Greenley and Otauna also discovered a discarded medal reading "Chewie,"<ref name="T&B">[[Tag & Bink Are Dead 2|''Tag & Bink Are Dead'' 2]]</ref> alluding to the fact that Chewbacca was seemingly forgotten in ''A New Hope''.<ref name="ANH" />

In the [[2006]] real-time strategy [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'', the Award Ceremony was featured in the ending of the Rebel campaign. However, its appearance should not be considered canon, since the victory over the Death Star can take place around any planet. The ceremony cutscene is even shown if Yavin 4 has been destroyed by the Empire earlier in the game. Additionally, the ceremony is shown following a battle over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] if the player wins by conquest instead of destroying the Death Star.<ref name="SWEAW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>

In [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']], a medal ceremony organized in [[3660 BBY]] in the honor of [[Hylo Visz]] was mentioned. The artwork depicting the ceremony mirrors the scene from ''Episode IV'', with the assembled troops on both sides of a long aisle, the slanted walls, and the dignitaries waiting on a podium with window-slits in the back.<ref name="JoMGD">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>

===Parodies in pop culture===
[[File:Family_Guy_Royal_Award.png|thumb|A parody of the ceremony shown in ''Family Guy'']]
As an iconic moment of the original ''Star Wars'' film, the Award Ceremony has been parodied in pop culture. The American animated sitcom [[Wikipedia:Family Guy|''Family Guy'']] has closed off an episode with a recreation of the ceremony, using sounds, music and even characters&mdash;Chewbacca and the droids&mdash;from ''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope''. According to the episode's DVD commentary, [[Lucasfilm]] permitted the use of copyrighted ''Star Wars'' elements in the episode.<ref name="MacFarlane">Commentators (2005). ''[[Wikipedia:Family Guy|Family Guy]] volume 4 Region 1 DVD commentary for the episode "Blind Ambition"'' (DVD). 20th Century Fox.</ref> Similarly, the animated series [[Wikipedia:My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic|''My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic'']] also featured an award ceremony sequence at the end of its twenty-eighth episode. According to director Jayson Thiessen, a storyboard artist decided to board the ceremony sequence as a shot-for-shot transposition of ''Star Wars'' Royal Award Ceremony.<ref>{{YouTube|video=OWAmh923ImE|text=BroNYCon September: Jayson Thiessen QnA|channel=channel/UCCaaliAcWycFhcKvNuDfW0w|name=LeoEmpire}}</ref> Another similar emulation was used in the fourth episode of the cancelled animated series [[Wikipedia:Undergrads|''Undergrads'']], in which the Award Ceremony was reenacted in the hallways of a college. One of the caracters, Mump, even beeps and whistles like R2-D2.<ref>{{IMDb|title/tt0772667|Undergrads: New Friends}}</ref> In the eleventh episode of the adult animated sitcom [[Wikipedia:Drawn Together|''Drawn Together'']], Captain Hero's fantasy wedding also parodies the Royal Award Ceremony, with characters from the show standing in for ''Star Wars'' characters.<ref>{{IMDb|title/tt0566093|Drawn Together: Captain Hero's Marriage Pact}}</ref>
